mapper.select: SELECT definition::text FROM nw_agent_teams WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_teams SET revision=#{revision},status='disabled',definition=#{definition}::jsonb WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE nw_agent_teams SET revision=#{revision},status=#{status},definition=#{definition}::jsonb WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE nw_agent_teams SET revision=#{revision},published_revision=#{publishedRevision},status='published',definition=#{definition}::jsonb WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT v.definition::text FROM nw_agent_teams t JOIN nw_agent_team_versions v ON v.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND v.team_id=t.id AND v.revision=t.published_revision WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{id} AND t.status='published'

SELECT (v.definition->'team')::text FROM nw_agent_teams t JOIN nw_agent_team_versions v ON v.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND v.team_id=t.id AND v.revision=t.published_revision WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{id} AND t.status IN ('published','disabled')
SELECT definition::text FROM nw_agent_team_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND team_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT definition::text FROM nw_agent_team_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND team_id=#{id} ORDER BY revision DESC

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_user_teams t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.team_id=#{team} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_channel_agent_bindings b JOIN nw_channels c ON c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.id=b.channel_id AND c.status='active' JOIN nw_chat_client_profiles p ON p.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND p.channel_id=t.channel_id AND p.client_ref=t.client_ref JOIN nw_end_users u ON u.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND u.id=p.end_user_id AND u.status='active' WHERE b.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND b.channel_id=t.channel_id AND b.agent_id::text=#{agent}))
SELECT definition::text FROM nw_agent_teams WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
